parse_instance_data: parse raw instance data from Minecraft schematics into segments, touching relationships, and metadata
parse_segments_into_file: parse instance segment data from a pickle file and save the parsed result to a new file
get_seg_context_sparse: sample a random segment and its context from parsed segment data with configurable drop percentage
get_inst_seg_example: generate a training example with context and segment tensors from parsed segment data
SegmentContextInstanceData: create a PyTorch dataset for segment-context instance segmentation with configurable context and segment sizes
